prompts.name: sdpm-spec
prompts.description: Shape a deck together in dialogue — audience, message, outline — before it is built (spec mode).

arguments.description: Path (or ID) of the deck to translate.

arguments.name: language
arguments.description: Target language, e.g. en, ja.
